**Finding: Compliant** (rule MFN — Most-favoured-nation obligations burdening Customer)

- **No MFN burdens Client.** I reviewed Compensation (§5) and Client's Covenants and Warranties (§8), and searched for "most favored", "no less favorable", "favourable", "best", and "any other party". Nothing requires Client to extend TrueLink terms given to third parties or to match third-party offers.
- **The only best-terms provision runs in our favour**, in §6 (Documentation and Disputes): TrueLink's Hosting Services rates "will not exceed that charged by TrueLink to any other party," coupled with a one-year price freeze. Per the rule's detection guidance, a Vendor-granted MFN is marked compliant and left intact.
- This sits at the **preferred position**, not the fallback, so no redline was proposed.
